scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Move left,
move right~!
And step...!
Dancing can be
more than a hobby.
For me, it's a way of life~
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
左移，右移~！
还有舞步...！
舞蹈不仅仅是爱好。
对我来说，它是一种生活方式~

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
The land of Midgard
is in need of talented women
to subtly change the balances
in the battle between good
and evil.
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
米德加尔特这片土地，
需要才华横溢的女性，
在正邪之战中，
微妙地改变平衡。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Are you ready
to take up this role,
and become a Gypsy?
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
你准备好承担这个角色，
成为一名冷艳舞姬了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
当你准备好了，
随时欢迎回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回来之前，
用完你剩余的所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Congratulations!
As a Gypsy, I know
that your performances
sway the hearts of all
those who will be watching...
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
恭喜！
作为冷艳舞姬，我知道
你的表演
将打动所有观看者的内心...

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
欢迎来到
英灵殿，
荣耀之厅。

scripts.text:
[Gypsy]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[冷艳舞姬]
请在这里
安心休息。
向勇士们致敬！
